limitations.note: The patch fixed counting on invalid cycles but also suppressed valid_b during gaps at count five and tied ready_a high, changing the output timing and reset handshake that the reference preserves.
The test exercised input gaps and reset but expected the rewrite’s valid_b gating and constant-high ready_a, so it could not catch either behavior change.
